jobs_results.title: Middle/Senior Frontend (React) developer (Pre-Sale)
jobs_results.description:
ETEAM is a seasoned digital product agency specializing in transformative growth for different types of businesses, from VC-backed startups to the largest company in the world, for the last decade.

On behalf of our future client, ETEAM is looking for a Middle/Senior Frontend (React) developer on a full-time basis.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the design and development of advanced web applications using React.js
• Architect scalable and reusable components and libraries for use across projects
• Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance and support
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to translate requirements into technical solutions
• Optimize application performance and ensure a smooth user experience across devices and browsers
• Stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices in front-end development

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
• 3+/5+ years of experience as a React... Developer
• Expertise in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and related web technologies
• Strong proficiency in React.js and its ecosystem (e.g., Redux, React Router)
• Experience with responsive design and cross-browser compatibility
• Solid understanding of front-end build tools and CI/CD pipelines
• Excellent problem-solving, leadership, and communication skills
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
• Upper-intermediate written and spoken English

We offer:
• Competitive Compensation Package: Enjoy a competitive compensation package, ensuring you're well-rewarded for your contribution
• Meaningful Projects: Projects that leverage modern technologies, allowing to work on up-to-date innovation
• Positive Environment: We believe in collaboration, transparency and a supportive workspace where everyone's contribution matters
• Results-Driven Approach: We've minimized bureaucracy and micromanagement to let you focus on what you do best
• Work-life balance. Flexible schedules and extended paid vacations are essential to stay refreshed and productive in the long run
• Language Development: Benefit from in-house English courses and interactions with clients and teammates, enhancing seamless global communication
• Engaging Team Activities: Be a part of various team-building activities and corporate events that boost morale, help bond with the team, and create sweet memories

Why Us: Our Values, Your Benefits.
• Join our team, spread across 17 countries, and enjoy the benefits of working in a global company. Our multicultural setup promotes appreciation, respect, creating a rich and rewarding work environment
• Our core values are Collaboration, Accountability, Transparency, and Mastery. These principles guide us and inspire our endeavors every day
• Location is not a barrier when it comes to providing you with all the necessary equipment to perform your job effectively. Rest assured that you will have everything you need, regardless of where you are located
• We care about giving back. By joining us, you'll be part of a community that contributes to charity and positively impacts others

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
THE COMPANY

Hello, we are Workpath, a B2B startup in the heart of Munich. We want companies and teams to work as effectively and inspired as possible. This is why we built a platform which streamlines goal setting, enables autonomous teams and simplifies cross collaboration. We pride ourselves in building a product which is easy and fun to use.

Most of our team is located in Munich or elsewhere in Germany, but we have a handful of software engineers working from Spain.

THE STACK

Our frontend is a single-page application, built with a mix of ES6 and TypeScript, as well as React. Further technologies we use are react-query, styled components, jest and react-testing-library.

On the backend we use Ruby on Rails, Postgres and Redis. Our infrastructure is hosted on AWS, and we have a solid CI/CD setup which allows us to spin up QA environments and deploy to production with a simple click of a button.

THE JOB

Here is where you come in: We are looking for a Frontend Engineer - React... (f/m/d) who enjoys creating business applications with great UX. You will work with a small but highly experienced, diverse and fun team of engineers, designers and product specialists. Some of the challenges you will face:
• Ship exciting features, enriched with animations and great UX.
• Eliminate tech debt and reduce inconsistencies. (Yes, you will get dedicated refactoring time!)
• Work with your colleagues to improve processes, architecture, and all other aspects of your work.

You will also:
• Have a say in which product features are developed.
• Own projects across the whole development lifecycle.
• Shape architectural, technical and organizational decisions.

WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF …
• You have demonstrated ownership and autonomy at work.
• You have deep knowledge in developing complex, scalable and cross-browser user interfaces and component libraries using React.
• Your foundations are solid. You have in-depth CSS experience and know how the browser works under the hood.
• You promote and apply software craftsmanship, clean code and robust tests.
• You have contributed to architectural decisions. You know how to break down a larger problem into smaller steps.
• An intuitive understanding of good design, typography and UX.
• Your desire to teach and learn is bigger than your ego.
• Excellent communication skills and fluent English. You are able to present complicated solutions to non-technical audiences in a simple and logical way.

WHY YOU SHOULD BE INTERESTED

Since work is a huge part of your life we want it to be interesting and fun. We work hard, we care for each other and always walk away satisfied. We constantly refine our approach and everyone has a say. If you like a challenge you will love it here.
• Opportunity to develop along our technical or team leadership career paths.
• A strong team and feedback culture, as well as collaboration in an agile working environment of mutual support and very flat hierarchies.
• A lot of personal responsibility, autonomy and creative involvement in shaping our growth, check our Youtube Podcast and listen to our team members.
• Remote work from anywhere in Spain, with a regular unlimited employment contract.
• Competitive compensation in addition to benefits & perks such as mobility subsidy through Edenred, and personal development budget.
• Regular paid visits to our Munich office for company events.

If you made it until here you probably want to talk to us. Hit the apply button

jobs_results.title: SENIOR FULLSTACK REACTJS & NODEJS DEVELOPER
jobs_results.description:
¿Te gustaría ayudar a coaches, entrenadores y nutricionistas a escalar su negocio? 🤔

Nuestro cliente es una empresa joven con base en Madrid dedicada al diseño y desarrollo de

una aplicación para ayudar a los profesionales de la salud a escalar su negocio. 🚀🚀🚀

Son un equipo de desarrolladores apasionados por crear una herramienta pionera que cambie

el modo de entender el desarrollo profesional de fisioterapeutas, profesores de yoga, pilates,

nutricionistas etc.

Entre sus funcionalidades se encuentra la creación de calendarios, gestión de pagos,

comunicaciones, evolución del negocio a través de página web, fidelización de clientes etc,

gestión de clases online, automatizaciones, gestión de clientes, realización de reservas, gestión

de equipo, gestión de documentos, entrenamientos,, creación de planes nutricionales, librería

de alimentos.

Si te gustaría ayudar a entrenadores a escalar su negocio... ¡no te pierdas esta oportunidad!

Tareas
• Trabajar mano a mano con un... equipo de 9 personas, en el salto de calidad de la aplicación.
• Relación directa con el CTO, además de participar en los procesos de contratación para ayudar a hacer crecer al equipo de producto de manera eficiente.
• Gestionar cambio de la arquitectura.
• Gestionar migración de la infraestructura.
• Desarrollar en back y en front dependiendo de los requerimientos.
• Construir interfaces de usuario sorprendentes en tecnologías web y móviles.

Requisitos
• +5 años de experiencia y que tenga pasión por el desarrollo, no limitarse a picar código.
• Interesado por el cambio de arquitectura de un sistema, implicado en hacer un salto de calidad, migración de tecnologías, performances etc.
• Experiencia con plataformas que estén escalando con un gran volumen de usuarios.
• JavaScript & Typescript
• MongoDB and NodeJS
• React Native
• Docker

Beneficios
• 100% teletrabajo u office. TÚ eliges. ☀️🌄💻
• Flexibilidad y autonomía.
• Retribución flexible. 💵
• Contrato indefinido. 📋
• Jornada intensiva viernes y verano. 😁
• Plan de carrera con posibilidades reales de escalar en funciones. 🚀
• Salario competitivo. 60.000€ brutos anuales.

Si te gustaría ayudar a entrenadores a escalar su negocio... ¡no te pierdas esta oportunidad
